/// 注册表以 `Arc` 持有回调；每次调用临时借用当前路由，决议本身不借用该路由。
/// 高阶生命周期约束使同一回调可接收不同派发轮次的路由视图。
// 候选数是记录数的保守上界；首个接管决议终止整条路由，实际只记录零或一次调用。

//! Runtime 导航回调的注册与派发入口，向外导出 [`UiNavigationDispatcher`]。
//! 路由由 Surface 准备，处理器决议由此层收集，焦点提交仍由 Surface 完成。

//! 用源码断言约束候选容量预留语句的保留。
//! 读取实现的测试挂载前部分，不执行派发，也不测量实际分配或性能。

final_ranged_objects.name: dispatcher (private module)
final_ranged_objects.audit: The path attribute mounts the implementation file privately. The public entry exposes the dispatcher type rather than the implementation namespace.
final_ranged_objects.documentation_decision: Added module-level Chinese responsibility and Surface/dispatcher boundary; path/module tokens unchanged.

final_ranged_objects.name: UiNavigationDispatcher (public re-export)
final_ranged_objects.audit: Re-exports the concrete Runtime behavior type mounted above. The parent dispatch root re-exports it to Runtime and Editor callers.
final_ranged_objects.documentation_decision: No additional one-line item doc: the new module explanation and concrete public type/method docs describe the same entry without repeating the name.

final_ranged_objects.name: HashMap, Arc and navigation contract imports
final_ranged_objects.audit: These use declarations bind the standard collections/ownership types, Runtime dedup helper and neutral Interface route/effect/result/node/tree types used by the implementation. They create no runtime state or callback registration.
final_ranged_objects.documentation_decision: No per-import comments: type and method contracts describe the meaningful ownership and behavior boundaries.

final_ranged_objects.name: NavigationHandler
final_ranged_objects.audit: Private Arc-owned trait object for a callback accepting UiNavigationDispatchContext with any route lifetime and returning an owned effect. Send, Sync and static constrain the stored callback; dispatch calls Fn synchronously.
final_ranged_objects.documentation_decision: Added two Chinese lines for Arc ownership and per-call route borrowing; the alias type and bounds are unchanged.
final_ranged_objects.lifecycle: The registry owns its Arc references. A route/context reference is borrowed only during the synchronous callback. The effect has no route lifetime.

final_ranged_objects.name: UiNavigationDispatcher
final_ranged_objects.audit: Owns a HashMap from (UiNodeId, UiNavigationEventKind) to a vector of registered callbacks. Default derives an empty map; the map's iteration order is irrelevant because dispatch performs direct keyed lookup.
final_ranged_objects.documentation_decision: Added responsibility, empty default, per-key order, owned results and Surface commit reference.

members.name: handlers
members.audit: A key identifies one node/kind; register appends Arc callbacks to its vector and dispatch borrows that vector. No serde or external registry owns this state.
members.documentation_decision: Kept the private field without a separate repetitive doc because type/register docs now explain its key, ownership and insertion order.

final_ranged_objects.name: impl UiNavigationDispatcher
final_ranged_objects.audit: Inherent methods separate mutable registration from shared dispatch. There is no custom Drop, serde implementation, external ABI or trait implementation in this impl.
final_ranged_objects.documentation_decision: No impl-level doc: the type and each public method now carry the relevant contracts.

final_ranged_objects.name: UiNavigationDispatcher::register
final_ranged_objects.audit: For a node/kind key, creates the vector if absent and appends Arc::new(handler). It returns unit, does not invoke the callback and does not check node existence. Matching callbacks later run in vector insertion order.
final_ranged_objects.documentation_decision: Added summary, parameter semantics, callback bounds/ownership, use timing and link to dispatch; no empty unit-return section.

parameters.name: self
parameters.contract: Exclusive borrow of the registry during append.

parameters.name: node_id
parameters.contract: Registration key component; no tree is available to validate it.

parameters.name: handler
parameters.contract: Generic F satisfying the explicit HRTB Fn + Send + Sync + static bounds, moved into Arc.

final_ranged_objects.returns: Unit. The next matching dispatch can observe the newly appended callback.

final_ranged_objects.name: UiNavigationDispatcher::dispatch
final_ranged_objects.audit: Consumes a supplied route, selects bubbled nodes when target is Some and root targets otherwise, deduplicates first occurrences, and invokes matching callbacks in registration order. Unhandled is not recorded. First Handled or valid Focus records one invocation and stops the outer route loop. Focus checks existence through the read-only tree before recording; the returned result owns the original route and optional target.
final_ranged_objects.documentation_decision: Added timing, parameters, owned return, MissingNode condition, ordering, deduplication, Surface/default-navigation boundary and verified Surface method reference. Added one private capacity rationale at the initialization block.

parameters.name: self
parameters.contract: Shared registry borrow; Fn callbacks are synchronously called on the current thread.

parameters.name: tree
parameters.contract: Shared tree borrow used by the Focus branch to check target existence; this method does not commit focus.

parameters.name: route
parameters.contract: Owned route whose candidate vector order is accepted as supplied; moved into the result on success.

final_ranged_objects.returns: Result<UiNavigationDispatchResult, UiTreeError>; success has the original route and zero/one recorded non-Unhandled effect. A missing Focus target returns MissingNode immediately.

control_points.name: route_kind and candidate selection
control_points.effect: target Some selects bubbled; target None selects root_targets.

control_points.name: empty fast path
control_points.effect: Either candidates or global handler map empty returns constructor-empty result.

control_points.name: ordered route loop
control_points.effect: Iterate the selected slice in its provided order.

control_points.name: duplicate node continue
control_points.effect: A repeated node skips before handler lookup.

control_points.name: missing key continue
control_points.effect: Only the exact node/kind callback vector is invoked.

control_points.name: Unhandled branch
control_points.effect: Continue handlers without storing an invocation.

control_points.name: Handled outer break
control_points.effect: Store one invocation and handled_by, then stop every later handler/node.

control_points.name: Focus existence/error branch
control_points.effect: Missing target returns MissingNode through ? before recording.

control_points.name: valid Focus outer break
control_points.effect: Store one invocation, handler and focus target, then stop the route.

control_points.name: owned result
control_points.effect: Move the original route and local records into Ok result.

final_ranged_objects.name: optimization_tests (conditional module)
final_ranged_objects.audit: cfg(test) and the explicit path mount the single source-guard test file. It is absent from non-test builds.
final_ranged_objects.documentation_decision: Existing short attributes and declaration are explicit. Added the proof-limit explanation in the mounted test module instead of changing the mount.

final_ranged_objects.name: navigation_dispatch_reserves_candidate_invocation_upper_bound
final_ranged_objects.audit: One test reads ../dispatcher.rs as raw compile-time text, takes the prefix before the first literal test-cfg marker, and asserts that the exact capacity-reservation statement exists. It does not execute a dispatcher or observe allocation/performance.
final_ranged_objects.documentation_decision: Added a module-level Chinese explanation of the static proof boundary. Existing test name and one assert remain unchanged.

gapfree_semantic_blocks.name: Private implementation mount
gapfree_semantic_blocks.entry: Compilation of the navigation module by dispatch/mod.rs.
gapfree_semantic_blocks.state_change: Selects dispatcher.rs using the path attribute and keeps its module private.
gapfree_semantic_blocks.downstream: The implementation provides the public type re-exported below.
gapfree_semantic_blocks.documentation_decision: New module docs explain the behavior boundary; no attribute or visibility change.

gapfree_semantic_blocks.name: Public behavior re-export
gapfree_semantic_blocks.entry: After the implementation module is declared.
gapfree_semantic_blocks.state_change: Exports UiNavigationDispatcher, with no initialization or dynamic registration here.
gapfree_semantic_blocks.downstream: dispatch/mod.rs:19 exposes the Runtime dispatcher root.
gapfree_semantic_blocks.documentation_decision: Existing declaration plus module docs suffice; no redundant re-export doc.

gapfree_semantic_blocks.name: Imports and neutral contract dependencies
gapfree_semantic_blocks.entry: Compile the private dispatcher implementation.
gapfree_semantic_blocks.state_change: Imports map/Arc, dedup helper, Interface route/effect/result/node/tree types; no initialization occurs.
gapfree_semantic_blocks.downstream: The alias and methods use these owned/borrowed contract types.
gapfree_semantic_blocks.documentation_decision: No import narration needed; relevant ownership is explained on the alias/type/methods.

gapfree_semantic_blocks.name: HRTB callback representation
gapfree_semantic_blocks.entry: Registration stores a handler as this private type.
gapfree_semantic_blocks.state_change: Arc owns the Fn trait object; route lifetimes remain borrowed inputs, with an owned effect output.
gapfree_semantic_blocks.downstream: The same handler can be called on later routes through a shared registry borrow.
gapfree_semantic_blocks.documentation_decision: Added lifecycle explanation before the alias.

gapfree_semantic_blocks.name: Empty-default registry storage
gapfree_semantic_blocks.entry: Construct a dispatcher, normally via Default.
gapfree_semantic_blocks.state_change: Derived Default initializes the map; vector order belongs to each node/kind entry.
gapfree_semantic_blocks.downstream: register appends and dispatch performs keyed lookup, without map-order dependence.
gapfree_semantic_blocks.documentation_decision: Added the public type contract; no separate private field repetition.

gapfree_semantic_blocks.name: Inherent implementation boundary
gapfree_semantic_blocks.entry: The type's inherent API is compiled.
gapfree_semantic_blocks.state_change: Separates the two public methods without implementing a trait.
gapfree_semantic_blocks.downstream: Registration requires exclusive access while dispatch uses shared access.
gapfree_semantic_blocks.documentation_decision: No separate impl doc because method contracts describe these borrows.

gapfree_semantic_blocks.name: Registration bounds and append
gapfree_semantic_blocks.entry: Caller supplies node_id, kind and a callback.
gapfree_semantic_blocks.state_change: entry/or_default/push appends one Arc; neither callback invocation nor node validation occurs here.
gapfree_semantic_blocks.downstream: Later dispatch of the same key observes this callback after earlier ones.
gapfree_semantic_blocks.documentation_decision: Added parameter, timing, ordering and lifetime documentation.

gapfree_semantic_blocks.name: Dispatch signature and ownership
gapfree_semantic_blocks.entry: Surface or another caller passes a tree view and an owned route.
gapfree_semantic_blocks.state_change: Borrows registry/tree and takes route by value.
gapfree_semantic_blocks.downstream: The route is borrowed by temporary contexts, then moved into a successful result.
gapfree_semantic_blocks.documentation_decision: Added method-level timing/parameter/return contract.

gapfree_semantic_blocks.name: Select the caller-supplied candidate list
gapfree_semantic_blocks.entry: At the start of dispatch.
gapfree_semantic_blocks.state_change: Copies route.kind; Some target selects bubbled, otherwise root_targets. No path is rebuilt.
gapfree_semantic_blocks.downstream: The selected slice determines outer traversal order and capacity hint.
gapfree_semantic_blocks.documentation_decision: Method documentation describes these alternatives; no branch paraphrase added.

gapfree_semantic_blocks.name: Empty-candidate or empty-registry fast path
gapfree_semantic_blocks.entry: Either selected candidates or the whole registry is empty.
gapfree_semantic_blocks.state_change: Returns UiNavigationDispatchResult::new(route) before visit-set/vector initialization.
gapfree_semantic_blocks.downstream: No callback runs and no handler/focus target is produced by this dispatcher.
gapfree_semantic_blocks.documentation_decision: Added this early-return condition to the public return contract.

gapfree_semantic_blocks.name: Visit tracking, capacity and result-state initialization
gapfree_semantic_blocks.entry: There are candidates and at least one registered map entry.
gapfree_semantic_blocks.state_change: Creates a route-local dedup set, reserves candidates.len for invocations, initializes both result markers to None.
gapfree_semantic_blocks.downstream: Subsequent traversal can record at most one non-Unhandled effect because both accepting branches exit the route.
gapfree_semantic_blocks.documentation_decision: Added one private rationale for the conservative capacity upper bound.

gapfree_semantic_blocks.name: First-occurrence node traversal
gapfree_semantic_blocks.entry: Each candidate in the supplied order.
gapfree_semantic_blocks.state_change: Inserts node_id into visited; duplicates continue before callback lookup.
gapfree_semantic_blocks.downstream: A repeated candidate cannot call that node's handlers again during this route.
gapfree_semantic_blocks.documentation_decision: Public method docs now state first-occurrence dedup; helper implementation was read as context.

gapfree_semantic_blocks.name: Per-node event-kind lookup
gapfree_semantic_blocks.entry: A candidate has not appeared earlier.
gapfree_semantic_blocks.state_change: Looks up the exact (node_id, route_kind) key; absent handlers skip this node.
gapfree_semantic_blocks.downstream: Only callbacks registered for both key components can run.
gapfree_semantic_blocks.documentation_decision: The type/register parameter docs describe the key; no repetitive branch comment.

gapfree_semantic_blocks.name: Temporary handler view
gapfree_semantic_blocks.entry: A matching callback vector exists.
gapfree_semantic_blocks.state_change: Creates a context with current node_id and a shared reference to the owned route.
gapfree_semantic_blocks.downstream: Callbacks can inspect the whole route without moving it.
gapfree_semantic_blocks.documentation_decision: Alias/register/dispatch lifecycle docs cover this temporary borrow.

gapfree_semantic_blocks.name: Registration-order callback loop and Unhandled
gapfree_semantic_blocks.entry: Iterate the matching vector in insertion order.
gapfree_semantic_blocks.state_change: Calls each Fn synchronously. Unhandled continues the inner handler loop and creates no invocation.
gapfree_semantic_blocks.downstream: When all handlers for a node decline, traversal moves to the next unique candidate.
gapfree_semantic_blocks.documentation_decision: Public docs distinguish continue from the two accepting effects.

gapfree_semantic_blocks.name: Handled records and stops the route
gapfree_semantic_blocks.entry: A callback returns Handled.
gapfree_semantic_blocks.state_change: Appends the Handled invocation, sets handled_by, then breaks the labelled outer loop.
gapfree_semantic_blocks.downstream: Later callbacks and later nodes are skipped; focus_changed_to stays None here.
gapfree_semantic_blocks.documentation_decision: Method docs say handler-chain termination, without promising Surface default-navigation suppression.

gapfree_semantic_blocks.name: Focus target existence gate
gapfree_semantic_blocks.entry: A callback returns Focus(target_node_id).
gapfree_semantic_blocks.state_change: tree.node checks existence; MissingNode propagates before an invocation or success result is returned.
gapfree_semantic_blocks.downstream: A missing target does not reach the focus-result recording branch.
gapfree_semantic_blocks.documentation_decision: Added the exact MissingNode error contract and read-only-tree boundary.

gapfree_semantic_blocks.name: Valid Focus records the target and stops the route
gapfree_semantic_blocks.entry: The Focus target exists in the borrowed tree.
gapfree_semantic_blocks.state_change: Appends the Focus invocation, sets handler and focus target, breaks the route.
gapfree_semantic_blocks.downstream: The caller can inspect the result; Surface later performs additional focus admission and commits its state.
gapfree_semantic_blocks.documentation_decision: Public docs and Surface reference explain who commits focus.

gapfree_semantic_blocks.name: Close handler and route loops
gapfree_semantic_blocks.entry: All callbacks decline or an accepting branch has exited.
gapfree_semantic_blocks.state_change: No extra fallback action or focus mutation is performed in this closing region.
gapfree_semantic_blocks.downstream: The accumulated route-local state is finalized below.
gapfree_semantic_blocks.documentation_decision: No comment required for delimiters; explicitly reviewed the absence of implicit fallback.

gapfree_semantic_blocks.name: Own the route in the final result
gapfree_semantic_blocks.entry: Traversal completed without MissingNode.
gapfree_semantic_blocks.state_change: Moves route into a fresh result, transfers invocations and both markers, returns Ok.
gapfree_semantic_blocks.downstream: Surface may apply default navigation and focus; Interface binding_reports stays constructor-empty here.
gapfree_semantic_blocks.documentation_decision: Return and Surface-reference documentation cover ownership and later consumption.

gapfree_semantic_blocks.name: Method and impl closing region
gapfree_semantic_blocks.entry: After early/final returns.
gapfree_semantic_blocks.state_change: Only structural closing braces and separator remain.
gapfree_semantic_blocks.downstream: The test module below is outside the inherent implementation.
gapfree_semantic_blocks.documentation_decision: No added delimiter comments.

gapfree_semantic_blocks.name: Conditional local test mount
gapfree_semantic_blocks.entry: Compile this implementation with cfg(test).
gapfree_semantic_blocks.state_change: Mounts dispatcher_optimization_tests.rs under optimization_tests.
gapfree_semantic_blocks.downstream: The test includes this implementation's raw text through a relative include_str path.
gapfree_semantic_blocks.documentation_decision: Existing attributes are explicit; proof scope documented in the test module.

gapfree_semantic_blocks.name: Local test declaration
gapfree_semantic_blocks.entry: The parent implementation's cfg(test) mount includes this file.
gapfree_semantic_blocks.state_change: Registers one standard test function; there is no ignore or performance harness here.
gapfree_semantic_blocks.downstream: The function body performs the source guard.
gapfree_semantic_blocks.documentation_decision: Added module-level proof-boundary docs; no repeated test-function summary.

gapfree_semantic_blocks.name: Raw source inclusion and prefix selection
gapfree_semantic_blocks.entry: The test function runs if selected by a Rust test runner; only static predicate evaluation was performed in this audit.
gapfree_semantic_blocks.state_change: include_str reads the dispatcher source literally; split/next takes the prefix before the first marker. Comments are not stripped. next is Some even if the marker is absent, so expect is not a separate delimiter-existence proof.
gapfree_semantic_blocks.downstream: The following contains assertion sees this raw prefix.
gapfree_semantic_blocks.documentation_decision: Module docs describe raw source scanning; markers and path string remain byte-identical.

gapfree_semantic_blocks.name: Single exact source predicate
gapfree_semantic_blocks.entry: A raw implementation prefix has been selected.
gapfree_semantic_blocks.state_change: Asserts the capacity statement occurs. Original/current predicate is true with one occurrence, and new comments contribute zero occurrences.
gapfree_semantic_blocks.downstream: Protects retention of that statement, not allocation count, timing, callback behavior or runtime upper-bound enforcement.
gapfree_semantic_blocks.documentation_decision: Preserved the assertion exactly; documented its narrow proof boundary instead of adding matching text.
